# ruv.sgit.ai

> sgit vaults and Agent Behaviour Policies (ABPs) running inside rUv's agentic stack (Ruflo, RuVector, RVM, MetaHarness): six proofs of concept in CI, in a browser and in a Claude Code session, plus a use-case driven guide to the stack. Built 14 Oct 2026 for Agentic Engineering Live: rUv in London.

## Pages
- [Home](https://ruv.sgit.ai/index.html): the story in one table, where sgit.ai plugs in, six use cases, what was proven
- [rUv's stack](https://ruv.sgit.ai/ruv-stack.html): Ruflo, RuVector, RVM, MetaHarness and the rest, by use, with the one command to start and what to ignore
- [Use cases](https://ruv.sgit.ai/use-cases.html): govern a swarm, remember across runs, prove what happened, publish only on approval, learn with rollback, run anywhere
- [Architecture](https://ruv.sgit.ai/architecture.html): layers, the ABP format and grammar, compile targets, the two vaults, data flow
- [The POCs](https://ruv.sgit.ai/pocs.html): flows, commands, acceptance criteria and real outputs for all six
- [Replicate](https://ruv.sgit.ai/replicate.html): install, run, vaults, CI secrets, this site, the infographics, build notes
- [Demo](https://ruv.sgit.ai/demo.html): the five-minute script
- [Tonight's talk](https://ruv.sgit.ai/talk/index.html): the scripted talk (10 and 5 minutes) as a timeline that plays on a clock, the run of show, sources for every number, questions to expect, rehearsals; [player](https://ruv.sgit.ai/talk/player.html), [timeline](https://ruv.sgit.ai/talk/talk-10.json)
- [The studio](https://ruv.sgit.ai/studio/index.html): seven animations of Ruflo + sgit + ABPs (diagram to 3D city) made by a Ruflo hive run, with MP4s, the timed trace and the builders' token use; [run record](https://ruv.sgit.ai/studio/run.json)
- [Articles](https://ruv.sgit.ai/articles/index.html): [The studio: plan and architecture](https://ruv.sgit.ai/articles/the-studio.md) · [Set it up: a brief any agent can follow](https://ruv.sgit.ai/articles/studio-setup-brief.md) (every article has a .md twin)
- [Live app](https://ruv.sgit.ai/app/index.html): ask the ABP in the browser (RuVector WASM)

## Releases
- [Release history](https://ruv.sgit.ai/admin/versions.md): every release, version, date, commit and changes; the version is in the nav of every page and increments on every push ([versions.json](https://ruv.sgit.ai/admin/versions.json))
